# PlayCode

> > PlayCode is a modern online code playground and IDE supporting JavaScript, React, Vue, TypeScript, Python, C++, and more with live coding and AI-powered features.

PlayCode provides a browser-based development environment for rapid prototyping and learning across multiple programming languages and frameworks. It features real-time preview, AI code generation, and support for popular libraries like Three.js, Svelte, Matplotlib, and Plotly.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript playground
- React development
- Vue.js
- TypeScript
- Online IDE
- Live coding
- AI code generator
- Three.js
- Python support
- Multi-language support
- Code playground
- Developer tools
- Svelte
- PostgreSQL
- C++ and C programming
